body.label: Target
body.html: Self or an adjacent willing ally.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 1; if protecting an ally, you may take any remaining Damage in its place.

surges.html: Resist 1 unit of forced movement from the triggering Action.
Suppress one Light Wound Condition's numerical penalties on yourself until the start of your next turn.
